bullets.text: Resolved 436+ support tickets across 10+ managed clients in a high-volume MSP environment covering Microsoft 365, Windows, networking, and endpoint security.
Handled inbound and outbound client calls and email support via Autotask, managing real-time troubleshooting requests and maintaining clear communication throughout each resolution.
Led phishing incident response: traced Amazon SES spoofing via SPF alignment failure, verified delivery via Exchange Admin Center, and blocked the threat in SpamHero.
Executed a network penetration test on a 60+ device network (Vonahi vPenTest) with no prior handoff, surfacing 7 Critical findings.
Administered Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and the full Kaseya ecosystem (Datto RMM/EDR, ThreatLocker, SaaS Alerts, Graphus, Inky, SpamHero, Duo) across 10+ client environments.
Delivered full-lifecycle user onboarding for 8+ users across 6+ clients: M365 provisioning, AD/OU setup, MFA/Duo, security stack (ThreatLocker, Todyl), logon scripts, and application setup.
Investigated security alerts including geographic login anomalies, bulk file downloads, and persistence events using Datto EDR, SaaS Alerts, and ThreatLocker.
Built internal tooling including a FuelMaster IFTA report converter and SharePoint/OneDrive anomaly utilities used directly in live client investigations.
Saved $2,870/year by reassigning a dormant Autodesk AEC Collection license.

Contributed to internal dev projects: construction job management platform (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL), CCTV investigation tooling, and a Python/Flask time-tracking app - stood up a Hyper-V dev environment to work around ThreatLocker restrictions.
Relocated from Islamabad, Pakistan to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; continued self-study in networking during the transition.
Built cloud and offline AI Interviewer platforms using Streamlit: cloud version uses OpenAI (LLM, STT, TTS); offline variant uses Ollama and Faster Whisper.
Designed a modular service layer (llm_service, stt_service, tts_service) with pluggable provider architecture and cross-platform one-command startup scripts.
Promoted from Trainee to Specialist within 2 months based on performance in client acquisition and bidding workflow optimization on Upwork and Freelancer.
Managed client pipeline in Odoo: scheduled calls, conducted requirements meetings, and handled project follow-ups.
Built a React dashboard automating Freelancer.com client data extraction, tracking bid success rates, and calculating team commissions.
Applied prompt engineering to train AI models for automated proposal writing and technical job description classification.
Developed bidding automation tools including Chrome extensions and WhatsApp bulk outreach, reducing manual effort in the BD pipeline.
Developed and customized WordPress themes and plugins (WooCommerce) using Elementor, optimizing for performance, security, and SEO.
Worked with PHP and Laravel on the backend alongside client-facing WordPress delivery.
Developed and delivered Android applications in Java/Kotlin with design and product teams, following sprint workflows in Trello.
Conducted code reviews and ensured smooth UX across delivered app features.
Handled 30-50 customer requests per day via Crisp, assisting users with popup/banner setup and automated email campaign integration.
Produced annotated screenshots and screen recordings as step-by-step guides; supported non-English-speaking clients.
Coordinated with the development team via Slack for feature requests and product feedback.
